entries.message: Fix - Make onboarding less text-heavy and stop requiring a media server
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Setup wizard step tabs are now evenly spaced across the full width instead of clustered to the left
Shortened the overview step's intro text and each card's description, and centered the intro

Media servers are no longer required to finish setup - manually marking titles watched works without one; the overview card, Review step, and sidebar reminder reflect this instead of blocking completion
Fixed cramped spacing between the TMDB card's Required and Configured badges on the Metadata step
